forecastReasoning.narrative:
Classic Dryline Cyclone governs the 12Z Day 1–12Z Day 2 period. The 12Z Day 1 issuance carries a HIGH maximum, with Slight-or-greater probabilities covering 35% of the domain. The primary corridor peaks near 15Z Day 1, when mean initiation reaches 9% and expected storm coverage reaches 4%.

A lee cyclone, sharpening dryline, and elevated mixed layer organize the warm sector while ascent approaches from the west. A representative corridor sounding contains about 5818 J/kg CAPE, 398 m²/s² SRH, 65 kt deep-layer shear, 1455 m LCLs, STP 9.7, and VTP 3.2. Flow increases from roughly 37 kt at 850 mb to 45 kt at 500 mb and 53 kt at 250 mb.

Maximum probabilities are 30% tornado, 0% hail, and 0% wind; tornadoes is the leading hazard signal. The analog ensemble has high agreement (95% confidence; 30 members), with mean moisture return 86%, clearing 85%, forcing 84%, and cap persistence 66%. No ensemble failure mode exceeds the reporting threshold.
supportingFactors: Coherent synoptic pattern and frontal geometry (96%)
Strong low-level hodograph curvature (398 m²/s² SRH)
Storm mode and conditional intensity support tornado potential
limitingFactors: Low or highly localized initiation signal (9% corridor mean)
Sparse expected storm coverage (4% corridor mean)

bustContributors.factor: Tornadic composite weakened through the valid period
